name: Centrifugal Pump KBS - structured knowledge base
created_for: CT-359 Knowledge Based System, stage KR-1

kr1_corrections.1: flow_fluctuation (SYM-22) and pressure_fluctuation (SYM-12) are separate symptoms with separate indicators (IND-10, IND-09)
kr1_corrections.2: Legacy F08 and F14 merged into FLT-11 Motor fault; electrical supply imbalance retained as distinct cause CAU-39
kr1_corrections.3: Indicators support absolute, pct_rated and pct_baseline bases; thresholds declare their basis; equipment_parameters holds rated and healthy-baseline references
kr1_corrections.4: Knowledge support quality (support_level, validation_status) is recorded separately from diagnostic likelihood (rule conclusion likelihood)

support_level.Strong: Stated by an independent source that was read (standards body, Hydraulic Institute, DOE/HI)
support_level.Moderate: Stated only by a manufacturer or trade source that was read
support_level.Unvalidated: Only in project sources (legacy KB, synthetic dataset, design documents) or no source read
support_level.Disputed: Contradicted by an independent source in the stated context
support_level.Definitional: True by definition or design decision; no external evidence needed

likelihood.confirmed: A confirming diagnostic test result matched
likelihood.likely: Pattern is characteristic of the conclusion
likelihood.possible: Pattern is compatible with the conclusion but not characteristic
likelihood.not_applicable: Rule does not conclude a hypothesis (negative evidence, blocking, test requests)

measurement_basis.pct_rated: Value as % of the equipment's rated parameter
measurement_basis.pct_baseline: Value as % of the equipment's healthy-baseline parameter

cost_downtime_class.LOW-MEDIUM: Range: the record merges legacy records whose classes differ (lowest to highest of them)
cost_downtime_class.MEDIUM-HIGH: Range: the record merges legacy records whose classes differ (lowest to highest of them)
cost_downtime_class.UNKNOWN: No legacy or researched source gives a value
cost_downtime_class.NOT_APPLICABLE: Diagnostic outcome, not a maintenance task

maintenance_priority.P1-immediate: make_safe action, or an action for a fault that has an active operating safety warning
maintenance_priority.P2-high: Action for at least one confirmed or likely fault or root cause
maintenance_priority.P3-planned: Any other recommended action (only possible hypotheses, or further investigation)

assumption_types.exclusion: An absent-condition used only to keep competing faults out; does not lower rule support
assumption_types.discriminator: An unvalidated condition the rule's conclusion depends on; rule support must then be Unvalidated

policies.threshold_selection: Use the default threshold for the most specific basis whose reference parameter is available: pct_baseline, then pct_rated, then absolute

likelihood_display_cap.rule: If a rule's support_level is Unvalidated, its conclusion is reported at most as 'possible' and labelled unvalidated. The stored likelihood is not changed.

policies.negative_evidence: A 'lower' conclusion reduces a hypothesis by one result_status level (likely -> possible -> unlikely)
policies.safety_rules: Evaluated for every hypothesis at or above trigger_min_status, independent of ranking
policies.ranking: Within a result_status, order by support_level of the best fired rule, then number of fired rules, then hazard_class

cost_and_downtime.rule: Faults and maintenance actions carry qualitative cost_class and downtime_class only. Values are inherited from the legacy KB (P-01) and are Unvalidated; no monetary or time values are given because no source provides them.

maintenance_priority.rule: Assigned per recommended action by the decision-support layer using the maintenance_priority vocabulary. It uses only operating safety warnings, action purpose and the diagnostic status of the faults/causes the action addresses. It does not use hazard_class, cost or downtime, and it never changes diagnostic results. Within a level, actions keep the engine order (legacy sequence, then id).
maintenance_priority.note: Project design policy (Step 1); not validated against site maintenance practice

files.equipment_parameters.csv: Rated, baseline and limit parameters per equipment
files.indicators.csv: Measured quantities and supported measurement bases
files.thresholds.csv: Indicator -> symptom thresholds with basis and provenance
files.faults.csv: Faults and outcomes with hazard class provenance
files.diagnostic_tests.csv: Diagnostic tests and their result values
files.relationships.csv: All typed relationships with provenance and validation status
files.diagnostic_rules.json: Diagnostic, negative, cause, chain and test-request rules
files.legacy_mapping.csv: Crosswalk from the legacy KB IDs
